title: Equal Sum Grid Partition II
description:
You are given an m x n matrix grid of positive integers. Your task is to determine if it is possible to make either one horizontal or one vertical cut on the grid such that: 

 Each of the two resulting sections formed by the cut is non-empty . 
 
 The sum of elements in both sections is equal , or can be made equal by discounting at most one single cell in total (from either section). 
 
 If a cell is discounted, the rest of the section must remain connected . 

 Return true if such a partition exists; otherwise, return false . 
 
 Note: A section is connected if every cell in it can be reached from any other cell by moving up, down, left, or right through other cells in the section. 

 Example 1: 

 Input: grid = [[1,4],[2,3]] 
 
 Output: true 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2025/03/30/lc.jpeg] 

 A horizontal cut after the first row gives sums 1 + 4 = 5 and 2 + 3 = 5 , which are equal. Thus, the answer is true . 

 Example 2: 

 Input: grid = [[1,2],[3,4]] 
 
 Output: true 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2025/04/01/chatgpt-image-apr-1-2025-at-05_28_12-pm.png] 

 A vertical cut after the first column gives sums 1 + 3 = 4 and 2 + 4 = 6 . 
 
 By discounting 2 from the right section ( 6 - 2 = 4 ), both sections have equal sums and remain connected. Thus, the answer is true . 

 Example 3: 

 Input: grid = [[1,2,4],[2,3,5]] 
 
 Output: false 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2025/04/01/chatgpt-image-apr-2-2025-at-02_50_29-am.png] 

 A horizontal cut after the first row gives 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 and 2 + 3 + 5 = 10 . 
 
 By discounting 3 from the bottom section ( 10 - 3 = 7 ), both sections have equal sums, but they do not remain connected as it splits the bottom section into two parts ( [2] and [5] ). Thus, the answer is false . 

 Example 4: 

 Input: grid = [[4,1,8],[3,2,6]] 
 
 Output: false 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 No valid cut exists, so the answer is false . 

 Constraints: 

 1 <= m == grid.length <= 10 5 
 
 1 <= n == grid[i].length <= 10 5 
 
 2 <= m * n <= 10 5 
 
 1 <= grid[i][j] <= 10 5
code: class Solution {public:bool canPartitionGrid(vector<vector<int>>&grid){int m=grid.size(),n=grid[0].size();long long total=0;unordered_map<int,int> all;for(auto&r:grid)for(int x:r){total+=x;all[x]++;}auto check=[&](bool horizontal){int rows=horizontal?m:n,cols=horizontal?n:m;unordered_map<int,int> first,second=all;long long sum=0;for(int i=0;i<rows-1;i++){for(int j=0;j<cols;j++){int x=horizontal?grid[i][j]:grid[j][i];sum+=x;first[x]++;if(--second[x]==0)second.erase(x);}long long d=2*sum-total;if(d==0)return true;if(d>0){if(i==0){int a=horizontal?grid[0][0]:grid[0][0],b=horizontal?grid[0][n-1]:grid[m-1][0];if(d==a||d==b)return true;}else if(cols==1){int a=horizontal?grid[0][0]:grid[0][0],b=horizontal?grid[i][0]:grid[0][i];if(d==a||d==b)return true;}else if(first.count((int)d))return true;}else{d=-d;if(i==rows-2){int a=horizontal?grid[m-1][0]:grid[0][n-1],b=horizontal?grid[m-1][n-1]:grid[m-1][n-1];if(d==a||d==b)return true;}else if(cols==1){int a=horizontal?grid[i+1][0]:grid[0][i+1],b=horizontal?grid[m-1][0]:grid[0][n-1];if(d==a||d==b)return true;}else if(second.count((int)d))return true;}}return false;};return check(true)||check(false);}};
